A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ISS/NMR research. Their complete main texts, appendices, equations, tables, and rendered figures support reliable comparison, including material relocated between versions.

before.justification: v1 reports original policy evaluations on AGNOSTOS, attribution correlations, perturbation experiments, hyperparameter analyses, and computational measurements in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including task success rates, ISS comparisons, sensitivity analyses, and latency measurements.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 retains the same Bernoulli masking, Gaussian-blur replacement, action-deviation aggregation, normalization, and temporal interpolation. The ISS/NMR procedure and evaluated policy are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 41 AGNOSTOS manipulation tasks: 18 seen tasks and 23 unseen tasks divided into 13 Level 1 and 10 Level 2 tasks. The perturbation scenarios and qualitative examples are retained.

E2.justification: Attention score (ATT) and token norm (NORM) remain the comparison methods in the robustness and fidelity experiments. Figure 12 retains the same ViT/VLM baseline visualizations; no evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: The training and evaluation protocols remain unchanged, including 3,600 training episodes, 575 unseen evaluation episodes, 25 trials per task, perturbation sample sizes, metrics, and hyperparameter sweeps. Both versions select N=100 and p=0.3.

E4.justification: Both retain Gaussian-noise robustness tests, geometric/patch/texture fidelity tests, masking-parameter and top-k sensitivity analyses, and the same qualitative cases. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both report five evaluation seeds, explicitly listed as 0, 13, 50, 77, and 99 in Appendix C.2. Repetition counts, mean-and-standard-deviation reporting, and plotted uncertainty displays are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 and the plotted results match, including NMR@10 correlation r=-0.77 and seen/unseen success rates of 59.07±0.58% and 24.00±1.92%. Figure 13 retains the same episode outcomes; its corrected split caption does not introduce new results.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, conditional-independence propositions, unbiased-estimator proof, and Gaussian MSE–KL derivation are retained. Minor notation corrections do not change the mathematics or assumptions.

C1.justification: The conclusion replaces the broad prediction and ISS-superiority summary with a statement that NMR tracks generalization, explicitly supported by its correlation with AGNOSTOS task success. The abstract and introduction retain the original central claims, so the narrowing is limited to the concluding summary.

C2.justification: The unimodality, computational-cost, and nuisance-mask limitations and future-work proposals move unchanged from Appendix G to Section 6. Mechanism explanations remain unchanged, and the conclusion's correlation-focused interpretation was already present in Section 5.1 and Appendix D.1.

D1.justification: v2 adds a first-page GitHub code-access link absent from v1. Implementation, hardware, training, preprocessing, and baseline-extraction details otherwise remain unchanged. The PDFs establish the new access pointer, not the repository's contents or functionality.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are retained. Changes such as SayCan's author/year entry, publication venues, expanded author lists, and the ChatVLA-2 title are bibliographic updates to matching works rather than new literature or positioning.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited grammar and notation corrections, updates headers and bibliographic presentation, and promotes Appendix G to main-text Section 6, renumbering the conclusion. Most prose and the overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 2 moves earlier, Algorithm 1 is repositioned, and Figure 13 is resized with cleaned captions. Panel 13(d) changes 'Seen' to 'Unseen,' matching the task assignments already in Table 3. The figure and table inventory and substantive displays are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 adds a code-access pointer, makes existing limitations prominent in the main text, corrects Figure 13's split labeling, and ties its conclusion more explicitly to the observed AGNOSTOS correlation. These improve accessibility and clarity, while unchanged methods, theory, and empirical evidence limit the overall gain.
